sections.appearance: Yuzu has salmon pink wavy hair with short pigtails and a small braid on the left front side of her head,. She has several white ribbons attached throughout her hair. Halo ==== Yuzu's halo resembles an orange power button. Uniform ==== Yuzu wears a white, baggy jacket with the Millennium logo and black ends, with a yellow hoodie underneath. In her left pocket is what appears to be a Nintendo Switch gaming system. She also wears white sandals with a yellow Millennium logo. Firearm ==== thumb|Nyan's Dash|150px She uses a black H&K M320 Grenade Launcher with a light blue stock and yellow barrel tip painted in a way that resembles a Nintendo Switch. A screen playing a nyan cat video is attached to the breech. Millennium markings are imprinted on the receiver and the front vertical grip. thumb|Nyan's Dash Concept Art showing the Pike Munition|150px She also use a Pike Munition guided grenade occasionally. One for her EX skill set for direct contact and for her Normal skill set on air burst.

sections.personality: Yuzu is introverted and prefers remaining sequestered inside her locker. She is sensitive to what others think, which can sometimes emotionally damage her. However, she has recently become more courageous in taking on the outside world thanks to the support of her GDD friends. She is also incredibly skilled at video games.
